subject: Civil Engineering
title: Highway Safety Features
description: A quick, practical guide to Highway Safety Features.

hook.text: A car drifts off the road at 70 mph. The guardrail saves the occupants' lives.

buildup.text: W-beam guardrails deflect vehicles back to the road. Cable barriers flex and absorb impact.

discovery.text: Crash attenuators at gore points cushion impacts with sand barrels or crushable cartridges.

twist.text: Rumble strips alert drowsy drivers by vibration — simple grooves save thousands of lives.

climax.text: Clear zones keep the roadside free of rigid objects — 30 feet of forgiveness.

punchline.text: Highways assume drivers will make mistakes. The road forgives them.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a clear zone alongside a highway?
options: To provide space for future lane expansion
To keep the roadside free of rigid objects so errant vehicles can recover safely
To allow wildlife to cross the highway without obstruction
